messages:
Sam (AE): FYI — ZenithHealth POC kick tomorrow. Before we hand staging creds they asked for SOC 2 Type II summary, an ISO network diagram with peering callouts, and a signed pen-test attestation. They want to gate access. Who can drive?
Iris (SE): I can pull the diagrams and tech checklist. Quick clarifying q: does Zenith need the full SOC2 PDF or will an executive summary + control mapping suffice for procurement?
Marco (Security): Full SOC2 report is available but only under NDA. We can provide an executive summary + control narratives upfront. We do not share raw server logs or full intrusion timelines.
Ellen (Legal): I can sign the pen-test attestation. Please drop the attestation draft here with the exact phrasing you want for "report access" (NDA vs redacted).
cc-bot: Quick provisioning guidance: Hosted POC — staging creds in 48-72h; Dedicated/VPC peering — 4-7 business days. Pricing delta: Dedicated ~+20-35% for short-reserve pools.
Iris (SE): Operational note: if they require CMK/HSM for the POC that's only available on Dedicated. Also need Zenith's allowlist CIDR and a primary SRE contact.
Sam (AE): Contact is ops@zenithhealth.com. I'll request CIDR and confirm whether an NDA is ok for the SOC2 PDF.
Marco (Security): Draft attestation (paste below). Use this wording for Legal to sign:
```
Pen-test Attestation — Redwood Inference
- Customer: <ZenithHealth>
- Environment: staging test tenant
- Scope: auth flows, public API endpoints, selected integrations (see scope appendix)
- Assessment Summary: Third-party assessment completed on <month/year>. High/critical issues were remediated or accepted with documented mitigations. Full findings report available to customer upon execution of an NDA; redacted summary may be provided without NDA.
- Signatory: Authorized Legal signatory (name)
```
Ellen (Legal): That wording is acceptable. I'll sign once Marco confirms the <month/year> field and we confirm no raw logs will be shared. Marco, please confirm for the thread.
Marco (Security): Confirmed — replace <month/year> with the completed assessment month. We will not provide raw logs. Redacted findings ok without NDA; full report requires NDA.
Iris (SE): Tech artifact checklist (draft): SOC2 Type II PDF (NDA), Control narratives, ISO network diagram (with VPC peering callout), Pen-test attestation (signed), Short-lived staging API key + presigned SFTP location for artifact upload.
Sam (AE): Action items: 1) Marco: post final attestation with date. 2) Iris: prep ISO diagram and upload path. 3) Ellen: sign attestation after Marco confirms date. 4) Me: request CIDR + NDA confirmation from Zenith and push for Hosted staging if they accept constraints.
Sam (AE): Goal — get creds out within 72h if Zenith agrees to Hosted constraints. If they push Dedicated, surface the +cost and lead time immediately. I'll update once I hear back from ops@zenithhealth.com. :thumbsup:
